scientific_object: Evidence Packet -> one legal high-level intervention action; transport/provider is implementation detail

l0_local_batch.purpose: LLM-authored within-formulation local proposals for the L0 ablation

supported_transport_classes.FILE_HANDOFF: runner writes immutable request JSON; a fresh isolated ChatGPT/web UI/manual operator supplies response JSON; bridge validates and records hashes
supported_transport_classes.COMMAND_STDIO: runner invokes a declared CLI wrapper (for example OpenCode/Codex/other LLM CLI) with request JSON on stdin and reads response JSON on stdout
supported_transport_classes.HTTP_API: optional API adapter such as OpenAI/OpenRouter/other provider
supported_transport_classes.OTHER: allowed only if it preserves the same canonical I/O and provenance contract

before_first_llm_decision_of_a_matched_r: record backend/product/model identity as exposed by that runtime
record backend command/config hash when applicable
run_freeze_policy.backend_failure_policy: use the predeclared deterministic fallback or restart the entire affected matched run; never switch backend because one action/result looks poor
run_freeze_policy.cross_run_backend_changes: allowed only when predeclared and reported as runtime strata; primary confirmatory analysis should use one backend family where practicable

prospective_bugfix_record.fix: add frozen parameter_order and parameter_domains to the L0 provider-neutral request, as already required by the frozen L0 prompt/runtime binding

reproducibility_position: Reproducibility is defined by frozen controller I/O, action ontology, validators, payload runtime and per-call provenance. A proprietary API endpoint is not itself the scientific object.
